idea: Music clip in the backyard: Sunny the lion cub tries to roar but only says meow; Jimmy, Ava and Biscuit cheer him on until he finds his big brave ROAR. Lesson: never give up.
title: Baby Lion Can't Roar! 🦁 Never Give Up | Crayon Babies
description:
Sunny the baby lion wants to ROAR like a big lion… but only a tiny "Meow!" comes out! 🦁 Baby Jimmy, Baby Ava and Biscuit the puppy cheer him on in the backyard until he finds his big, brave ROAR.

🎬 What happens in this video:
🦁 Sunny tries to roar… "Meow?!"
🤗 Jimmy and Ava say "It's okay!"
🐶 Biscuit the puppy joins the roar practice
💪 "You can do it!"
🎉 ROAR!!! Sunny did it!
👋 Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: never give up, keep trying and cheer for your friends • English words: roar, lion, meow, brave, try again

A fun music cartoon for toddlers and preschoolers about trying again and never giving up.
